text.description_html:
Acorn RITBP, 15-5/8" Bean Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle

This Acorn made iron strap hinge will be sure to add an authentic old world finishing touch to any door. The Bean Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle has a rough iron finish that duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron. The 15-5/8 Inch Bean Tip Rough Iron Strap Hinge With Carriage Bolts is designed for gates 3 inches to 4 inches thick weighing up to 175 pounds. Comes packaged with carriage bolts.

Also Available: 18-7/8" Bean Tip Rough Iron Strap Hinge With Carriage Bolts or Click Here to see the entire Acorn Bean Tip Collection

Features of the Acorn Rough Iron Bean Tip Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish carriage bolts.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the 15-5/8" Bean Tip Strap Hinge With Carriage Bolts:

  • Length: 15-5/8"
  • Width: 1-9/16"
  • Gauge: .155
  • Pintle: 4-1/2"
  • Designed for gates 3" to 4" thick up to 175 lbs.

Sold Individually
